title: AI-found Java flaw lets attackers into Jira and Jenkins without a login
content:
A critical flaw in Java can let attackers run their own code on widely used business software without logging in. Security start-up Calif disclosed the bug, which it calls Java4Shell, on Tuesday, when Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes. Java powers 90% of Fortune 500 companies, according to Calif.
Calif found it with AI. Researcher Quang Luong pointed OpenAI’s Codex agent at Java’s internals, he wrote. He found the flaw in an hour and built the first working exploit in two more, for less than $200 in AI tokens. Calif used OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber model, The New York Times reported. The Times independently verified the attack in a test that took less than an hour.
The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-114938. The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has urged organisations to patch it immediately, The Hacker News reported.
64 letters and an equals sign
The bug sits in a fast version of Java’s Base64 decoder, which turns text back into binary data. Login headers, file uploads and network messages all use Base64. Calif says that 64 “A” characters followed by one “=” make the decoder write 62 bytes past the end of its memory. Java rejects the input, but only after the damage is done.
Calif says it ran code without an account on Keycloak, Atlassian’s Jira and Confluence, JFrog Artifactory, Jenkins and PingFederate, in their default settings. With a login, it did the same on Apache Kafka, Apache Solr, Elasticsearch, Gerrit and Spinnaker. The lists are incomplete, the company said.
The faulty code is in OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later, so distributions from Amazon, Microsoft, Red Hat, Azul, SAP and others are affected too. It runs only on Intel and AMD chips with a feature called AVX-512 VBMI. ARM chips are safe.
“Java is everywhere,” Thai Duong, Calif’s chief executive, told the Times.
There is no universal exploit, Calif said, and each application needs its own attack. The company is holding back its product-specific exploits until users have had time to upgrade.
A leak, and the first attempts
Calif said on X that news of the flaw had leaked before Oracle released its fix, The Register reported. The trigger was already public. A malformed input that causes the overflow was posted on 9 September in a proposed OpenJDK fix. Its author later closed it without merging, The Hacker News found.
Attackers are now probing. Security firm watchTowr said it was seeing exploitation attempts against its sensors. Other labs have reproduced crashes and memory leaks, but not yet the code execution, The Hacker News reported.
Not everyone likes the noise. Akamai’s Jan Schaumann accused Calif of “publicity-maxxing” on the Openwall mailing list, The Register reported. Calif’s write-up opens by saying it went after Java because many people did not know what PHP was. Oracle rates the flaw 8.1 out of 10 and hard to exploit; Calif rates it 9.2.
A wave of AI-found flaws
Java4Shell is Calif’s second major find in weeks, after the PHP2Shell flaws in October. On Wednesday, F5 patched 10 bugs in NGINX, the web server behind about a third of all websites. Two are critical, and researchers found them with AI help, The Register reported.
The rush to patch has its own cost. Banks and the NSA have told Congress that this week’s US tech outages came from rushed fixes for AI-found flaws, The Washington Sun reported.
Calif’s answer is to delete code. It calls the idea “vibe-uncoding”: using AI to find features and optimisations a system does not need, then removing them. The Base64 shortcut that caused Java4Shell helps few applications, the company said, but ships to everyone.

report.summary: AI一小时挖出Java致命漏洞，Jira等无需登录即可被攻破
report.background: Java 支撑着绝大多数财富500强企业的关键系统，Base64 解码器更是登录头、文件上传、网络消息的通用组件。安全创业公司 Calif 让 AI 代理直捣 Java 内部实现，一小时内定位漏洞，再用两小时写出首个可用攻击代码，成本不足 200 美元 Token。Oracle 与 OpenJDK 同步发布补丁，CISA 已要求组织立即修复。这也是继 10 月 PHP2Shell 之后，Calif 数周内第二次由 AI 主导发现的高危漏洞，同期 F5 也修补了 10 个由 AI 协助发现的 NGINX 漏洞。
key_points: 漏洞出在 Java 高性能 Base64 解码器：64 个字母 A 加一个等号，就能让内存在边界外多写 62 字节，Java 虽拒绝该输入，但破坏已经发生。
攻击面极广：默认配置下，攻击者无需账号即可在 Keycloak、Jira、Confluence、Artifactory、Jenkins、PingFederate 上执行代码；有账号时 Kafka、Solr、Elasticsearch 等也沦陷。
影响范围为 OpenJDK 17.0.6 及之后的版本，亚马逊、微软、红帽、Azul、SAP 等发行版均受波及；且只在支持 AVX-512 VBMI 的 Intel 与 AMD 芯片上可利用，ARM 架构安全。
AI 把漏洞挖掘从「人月」压到「人时」：研究员用一个 Codex 代理加 GPT-6 Cyber 模型，一小时发现、两小时做出首个利用，纽约时报独立复现也不到一小时。
补丁发布前消息已从 OpenJDK 提案泄露，watchTowr 传感器已捕捉到利用探测；Oracle 评为 8.1 分且难利用，Calif 自评 9.2 分，业界对「造势」也有批评。
Calif 提出「vibe-uncoding」思路：用 AI 找出系统中无人需要的功能与优化并删除，从源头缩小攻击面，而非持续追赶补丁。
report.impact: 对 AI 行业，这意味着漏洞挖掘进入「AI 对 AI」的新阶段，防御方补丁节奏被彻底打乱，仓促修复本身已造成本周美国大面积技术故障，银行与 NSA 已就此向国会作证。对开发者，任何运行 OpenJDK 17.0.6+ 的 x86 服务都需立刻升级，Jira、Jenkins 这类 CI 与工单系统往往是内网枢纽，风险被放大。对普通用户，短期内可能遭遇更多服务中断与数据泄露事件，但漏洞利用需要逐应用定制，暂不至于演变为蠕虫式全球瘫痪。
report.tools: 优先跟进 Oracle 与各发行版的 JDK 补丁公告，把 CISA KEV 目录接入运维告警；自查是否使用 Jira、Jenkins、Keycloak、Artifactory 等受影响组件并升级。想复现研究路径可关注 OpenAI Codex 代理与 GPT-6 Cyber（未公开）、watchTowr 的暴露面监测，以及 CodeQL、Semgrep 做自有代码的边界检查审计。
